item.title: Senate passes Public Service Commission expansion
item.description: MONTGOMERY — Legislation expanding the number of members of the Public Service Commission (PSC) passed the Senate unanimously on Thursday.State Sen. Pro-Tem Garlan Gudger (R-Cullman) announced on Tuesday the "Power To The People Act," a measure that expands the PSC from its current three seats to seven seats elected by the public.The Power To The People Act, sponsored by State Sen.
